title: RomanNumeralToNumbers
description: Basically, Roman Numerals to Arabic Numbers, like IX Turns into 9.
body:
Designed for Readablity
And so i wouldnt have to remember how to read the combat skill number in skyblock, this mod automatically converts msgs that have roman numerals in them, or item names into normal numbers, inspired by a mod in Badlion Client that did similar.

Made for Hypixel Skyblock (also works for Fakepixel Skyblock ig)

Report Bugs : https://dsc.gg/arizaltd
